pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-to-large irregular polygonal regions with soft edge gradients. Spatial area is greatest on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries on the lower neck and hindquarters. Patch edges exhibit low angularity with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, showing significant narrowing at the junctions between larger dorsal patches and widening along the lower flank regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, dense serration visible along the upper neck and shoulder line, characterized by a dark, short-haired fringe that creates a fine-toothed silhouette against the grey background brush.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly regular, grid-like sub-rectilinear patterning visible on the base of the tail and posterior hindquarters.
